Class CellCollisionSystem

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.CellCollision
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Cell-based collision system that partitions world space into a grid of cells of the specified size. Manages registration of ICellCollider instances, updates their positions each frame, moves them between cells, and invokes enter/exit and collision start/end callbacks accordingly.

Cell-based collision system that partitions world space into a grid of cells of the specified size. Manages registration of ICellCollider instances, updates their positions each frame, moves them between cells, and invokes enter/exit and collision start/end callbacks accordingly.

Methods

Add(ICellCollider)

Request registration of a collider with the cell collision system. If the collider is currently scheduled for removal this frame, the add will be rejected. The collider is enqueued and will be processed by ShapeEngine.Geometry.CellCollision.CellCollisionSystem.ProcessPendingColliders() on the next update.

public bool Add(ICellCollider collider)

Parameters

collider ICellCollider

The ICellCollider to add.

Returns

bool

True if the collider was successfully queued for addition; false if it was already scheduled for removal or already present in the add queue.

Clear()

Clears the collision system state and returns all pooled resources.

public void Clear()

Remarks

This method clears the pending add/remove queues, unregisters all colliders, and returns any allocated pooled CellCollisionSystem.Cell instances back to the pool. After calling Clear(), the system will be in an empty state with no registered colliders or active cells.

Close()

Closes the collision system and releases any managed resources.

public void Close()

Remarks

This currently delegates to Clear() to unregister colliders and return pooled cell instances.

DrawDebug(ColorRgba, ColorRgba, ColorRgba)

Draws a debug visualization of the collision grid. Renders grid lines for all tracked cells, optionally fills occupied cells, and draws an outer bounding rectangle around the active cell area.

GetAllColliders<T>(ref HashSet<T>)

Copies all registered colliders of type T into the provided result set. Iterates the internal registry and adds any collider that can be cast to T.

public int GetAllColliders<T>(ref HashSet<T> result) where T : ICellCollider

Parameters

result HashSet<T>

A reference to a HashSet<T> that will be populated with matching colliders. The set is modified in-place; duplicates are ignored.

Returns

int

The number of colliders added to result by this call.

Type Parameters

T

The collider concrete type to filter for. Must implement ICellCollider.

Remove(ICellCollider)

Schedule a collider to be unregistered from the collision system. If the collider is currently queued for addition this frame, it will be removed from the add queue. The actual removal will be processed by ShapeEngine.Geometry.CellCollision.CellCollisionSystem.ProcessPendingColliders() on the next update, which will call RemoveCollider(ICellCollider) to perform the removal and trigger any necessary exit/collision end callbacks.

public bool Remove(ICellCollider collider)

Parameters

collider ICellCollider

The ICellCollider instance to remove.

Returns

bool

True if the collider was successfully queued for removal (i.e. added to the internal removal set); false if it was already present in the removal queue.

Update(float)

Advance the collision system by a single frame. This will process any pending additions/removals, update all registered colliders' positions by dt, and resolve collisions for colliders that moved between cells during this update.

public void Update(float dt)

Parameters

dt float

Delta time in seconds since the last update.
